(NYSE: AMP) today announced that The Atlantic Group, a financial advisory practice managing more than $1.6 billion in client assets, has joined its branch channel from Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. Based in Boca Raton, Florida, the team comprises 16 professionals, including nine financial advisors and seven support staff. The practice is led by founding partners Andrew Lerner, APMA™, AWMA™, CFP®, ChFC®, and Logan Shalmi.
